10A.
Council to hear from applicants and make appointment of two Tenant Commissioners to the Housing Authority. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
City Council take the following actions: 1) Hear each applicant briefly explain his/her qualifications and interest in serving as a Tenant Commissioner to the Housing Authority; 2) discuss as needed; and 3) the Mayor, with approval from the City Council, appoint two Tenant Commissioners to the Housing Authority with terms ending June 2019.
2017-05-17 Item 10A Housing Authority Applicants-REDACTED
10B.
Proposed 2018 Major Special Events Review, Selection and 2018 Memorandums of Understanding. Contact Person: Management Analyst Roff
City Council review and authorize the proposed 2018 Major Special Events and 2018 Memorandums of Understanding.
2017-05-17 Item 10B 2018 Major Special Events Review, Selection and Memorandum of Understanding
10C.
Report on the results of the Interim Provisions of the Affordable Unit Policy (AUP) program and consideration of possible options to amend the AUP program and/or continue the Interim AUP program provisions. Contact Person: Senior Planner II Kusiak
Receive the report and direct staff to: 1) Continue the AUP program with its current provisions for one year, allowing time for accessory dwelling unit and unpermitted dwelling unit ordinances to be adopted, then reevaluate the AUP program in light of the adopted provisions and return to Council with recommendations to continue, revise, or end the program; 2) Continue work on SB 431 to seek legislative relief to allow local building officials discretion and flexibility to issue permits for existing, unpermitted dwelling units provided that health and safety standards are maintained; 3) Continue to work with the City's building permit and inspection services provider, EsGil Corporation, and the City's future Building Official, on possible application of existing building code provisions allowing alternate materials, alternate design and methods, and modifications to typical provisions to the legalization of unpermitted dwelling units; and 4) Develop an ordinance to provide a pathway to obtain permits for unpermitted dwelling units that cannot comply with the zoning relief proposed by the future accessory dwelling unit and junior accessory dwelling unit ordinances.
2017-05-17 Item 10C Results of the Interim Provisions of the Affordable Unit Policy REDUCED

Report and Council direction on proposed ordinances for accessory and junior accessory dwelling units. Case No. 16-285 POD. Contact Person: Senior Planner II Kusiak

Council consideration of a request to proclaim June 2nd National Gun Violence Awareness Day in the City. Contact Person: Mayor Blakespear

2017-05-17 Item 10F Council Consideration of a Request to Proclaim June 2nd National Gun Violence Awareness Day

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
